notes.title: 12 Mega forms to test
notes.body:
- Adds Mega forms for Serperior, Arcanine, Aggron, Altaria, Banette, Gallade, Heracross, Latios, Manectric, Sableye, Salamence, and Scizor.
- Use Multiplayer → Debug to grant a matching Mega Stone, then press L + R while choosing a move in battle.
- Mega forms last for that battle only. Save normally before testing; linked two-player battles and every form still need live playtesting.

notes.title: Mega Serperior menu fix
notes.body:
- Fixed a crash that could happen when opening the Pokémon menu after Mega Evolving Serperior.
- Mega Serperior stays in its battle form; the menu uses its normal icon where the game has no Mega icon.
- The launcher and game now share version 1.0.22. Open your existing launcher and install the update to test its download feature.
- To check the battle fix, use Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1, Mega Evolve Serperior, open the Pokémon menu, and finish the battle.
- Mega Evolution remains experimental. Save normally first; a live two-player Mega battle still needs testing.

notes.title: Mega Serperior test
notes.body:
- Mega Serperior now uses the supplied art in the game's DS sprite format.
- Its Mega form uses Sap Sipper instead of Contrary, so you can verify the ability change.
- The exact armed battle state now passes without a crash; your saved Pokémon stays unchanged.
- Use Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1, give Serperior Serperiorite, choose **Fight**, then press **L + R together** while choosing a move.
- Mega Serperior is the only Mega in this build. The feature is still experimental; save first. A live two-player Mega battle has not been tested.

notes.title: Mega battle crash fix
notes.body:
- Fixed the crash that could happen after choosing a move while Mega Evolving Serperior.
- Mega Serperior now keeps its form and stats through the battle, then returns to normal when the battle ends.
- To try it, use Black 2 Redux Complete v1.4.1, give Serperior Serperiorite, open Fight, and press L + R while choosing a move. The Multiplayer Debug tab can grant the stone.
- Mega Serperior is the only Mega in this build. Save normally before testing; live two-player Mega battles still need a test.

notes.title: Fix for a startup problem
notes.body:
- Fixed a Windows startup issue that could stop melonDS from opening.
- Close the emulator before updating, then start it again from the launcher.
- Mega Evolution gameplay was not changed in this update.

notes.title: Another Mega Serperior test
notes.body:
- Mega Serperior remains the only playable Mega in this test build.
- Start a fresh battle with Serperior holding Serperiorite, then press L and R together while choosing a move.
- Earlier testing did not confirm that the battle stays playable afterward. Save normally and treat this as experimental.

notes.title: Mega Serperior battle test
notes.body:
- The test build adds the custom Mega Serperior form and Serperiorite for the supported Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 game.
- Press L and R together while choosing a move. Use the Debug tab to grant the stone if needed.
- The replay did not cover a complete live battle, so this remains experimental. Save first.

notes.title: More Mega Serperior testing
notes.body:
- The test now checks Serperior's Mega form and battle stats during a replay.
- A live co-op battle still needs testing. Save normally before trying Mega Evolution.

notes.title: Mega Serperior arrives as a test feature
notes.body:
- Serperior can Mega Evolve in battle in the supported English Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 game.
- Give it Serperiorite, open Fight, then press L and R together. The Multiplayer Debug tab can grant a test stone.
- This feature is experimental. Save normally before trying it, and use the same version with co-op partners.

notes.title: Smoother LAN hosting
notes.body:
- Hosting a local game should feel smoother when several network events arrive together.
- The launcher and emulator now show the same version number. Your ROMs, saves, and settings are kept.

notes.title: Safer game updates
notes.body:
- Updates install alongside your current game, so a running game can finish before you switch.
- An unrelated melonDS copy no longer blocks Play or repair.
- Your settings, ROM, and saves stay in place.

notes.title: Safer Soaring landings
notes.body:
- You can see more ground and scenery while flying, and the debug view can show landing areas.
- The game now waits for the landing area to load before giving control back, helping prevent NPC conversations from getting stuck.
- Returning to take-off asks you to confirm. Flight also stays steadier during speedup.

notes.title: A wider Soaring view
notes.body:
- Soaring now shows more of the surrounding outdoor scenery, with distant areas softened by fog.
- Enable it under Settings → Experimental features, then choose Unova → Pokémon → Take flight.
- This is still a preview, not a complete map of Unova. The Town Map is not used.

notes.title: Smoother followers
notes.body:
- Fixed follower hitching and made follower movement smoother.
- A follower stays visible through brief data hiccups and updates correctly when your party or area changes.
- Shiny followers now follow the odds used by the loaded game.

notes.title: A one-time launcher repair
notes.body:
- If an older shortcut keeps opening an outdated launcher, run Repair-Launcher.exe once and select the shortcut's original Pokémon Together.exe.
- Close the launcher if Windows asks; the repair never closes the game for you.
- Your ROMs, profiles, saves, and backups stay in place. See the launcher migration guide before running the repair.

notes.title: Launcher updates work more smoothly
notes.body:
- After an update, the launcher now opens the newly installed version.
- Older shortcuts can follow the newer launcher without changing your saves or settings.
- Soaring remains an experimental preview.

notes.title: A Soaring preview
notes.body:
- Search the practice trainer list by name or class before starting a no-reward battle.
- An optional Fly shortcut opens the game's own party menu and destinations.
- Free-flying over Unova is not included in this preview.

notes.title: More ways to enjoy your companion
notes.body:
- Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon; its reactions reflect its nature and friendship.
- Interactions are just for fun and do not change HP, friendship, items, or saves.
- Hold R and press A while facing your follower, or tap it, to open the menu.

notes.title: Balanced solo experience
notes.body:
- The solo experience bonus is now 1.25× instead of 1.65×.
- Existing experience, saves, and co-op rewards are unchanged.

## Separate launcher update — 13 October 2026

- A shared mod library adds separate Unova Together and Pokémon X pages.
- Launcher messages are shorter. Your Unova game, saves, and settings stay in place.
- Pokémon X still needs its separately prepared prototype. [Full launcher notes](LAUNCHER_NOTES_2026-10-13.md).

notes.title: Safely clean up old installs
notes.body:
- The launcher can remove unused old game copies to free space.
- It keeps the active game, one rollback copy, and running games. ROMs, saves, backups, and custom files are preserved.

notes.title: Easier save management
notes.body:
- Create separate game slots and keep their saves apart.
- Back up or restore saves from one place; the current save is backed up before a restore.
- Added a simple calculator to help plan solo experience.

notes.title: More experience in solo battles
notes.body:
- Solo battles now give extra experience to help make up for experience not earned while playing co-op.
- Co-op rewards and Pokémon you have already trained are unchanged.

notes.title: A reliability update
notes.body:
- Co-op reconnect and recovery checks have been improved.
- The launcher gives clearer connection information and safer retry options.
- This is mainly a behind-the-scenes maintenance update.

notes.title: The full release
notes.body:
- Explore together, see teammates, trade items or Pokémon, and battle with friends.
- Includes followers, companion interactions, co-op trainer battles, Pokémon tools, and optional battle scenery.
- The launcher adds profiles, LAN hosting, backups, verified updates, and installation repair.

notes.title: Companion interactions and a flight preview
notes.body:
- Talk to, pet, and play with your lead Pokémon. These interactions are cosmetic and do not change your save.
- Try an experimental flight preview over your current surroundings. The game's normal Fly menu still chooses destinations and landing spots.

notes.title: Quicker menus and safer reconnects
notes.body:
- Switch between Players, Pokémon, Co-op, and Settings from the tabs or with L/R.
- The Options shortcut now opens the right menu, and reconnects recover more cleanly.
- Follower controls and trainer battle settings are easier to find.

notes.title: Simpler menus and co-op tools
notes.body:
- Pokémon tools, co-op settings, and game options are easier to find.
- Choose solo or co-op trainer battles, start no-reward practice rematches, and challenge another player.
- Show or hide followers and see clearer teammate status messages.

notes.title: Helpful Pokémon tools
notes.body:
- Browse local encounters by season and relearn level-up moves for free.
- Use field moves while keeping those moves out of your battle move slots. The game still controls whether you can use them.

notes.title: Followers and party stats
notes.body:
- All 649 original Pokémon now have directional follower sprites.
- Followers have a gentle idle bob, and you can view IVs and EVs in the launcher tools.
- Viewing stats does not change your Pokémon.

notes.title: Battle scenery and followers
notes.body:
- Try optional 3D battle scenery made from your own ROM. It is cached on your computer and does not change your game files.
- Pokémon followers now use more accurate sprites and animations.
- Fixed the in-game Options shortcut.

notes.title: Bigger LAN lobbies
notes.body:
- Local games can now host up to 16 players, and guests can join after the host starts.
- Co-op invitations and reconnects are more reliable.
- Traded Pokémon follow the game's obedience rules in supported Black 2 versions.

notes.title: More reliable map tracking
notes.body:
- Nearby players are matched to the area they are actually visiting.
- Fixed several cases where a teammate's location or battle status could get stuck.
- Teammates can remain visible behind in-game menus when the game camera is available.

notes.title: Clearer player locations
notes.body:
- Teammate locations and battle status now recover more reliably after returning to the field.
- The player list gives a clearer message when someone's location cannot be found.

notes.title: Easy setup and co-op
notes.body:
- The launcher can check for updates, host or join a local game, and help you reconnect.
- It now includes setup guides, gameplay screenshots, optional music, and keyboard or controller navigation.
- Updates keep your ROM, saves, and emulator settings. Problem reports stay on your computer until you choose to share them.
